record.question: What is the significant amendment introduced by Section 187 of the BNSS, 2023 concerning police custody?
options: Police custody can now extend beyond 60 days without court approval
The 15-day police custody period can now be utilized in parts, at different times, within the first 40 to 60 days of the investigation
Police custody had been reduced to maximum of 7 days
Accused can no longer be remanded to judicial custody after initial police custody
